title: Disgrace
author: J.M. Coetzee
summary: David Lurie, a Cape Town professor, loses his job after an affair with a student and retreats to his daughter's farm. There, violence forces him to face a changing South Africa and his own limits.
readIf: you want a spare, morally difficult novel about power and post-apartheid society.
skipIf: you want a likeable protagonist or a story with a comforting resolution.
